node.title: Bridge 1: E_3-large = walk-trapping = non-expanding (elementary spectral bookkeeping)
node.statement: E_3(A) = <1_A, (P_A M P_A)^3 1_A> (the cubed restricted one-exchange operator), so E_3 large implies large local spectral radius of M on A, which implies small edge expansion of A in J(n,j) (Courant-Fischer). Connects our energy functional to the expansion language of the literature.
node.notes: PACKET WRITTEN (wave 1): full proofs + verifier 167/167 green in-branch — the walk identity, spectral cap, and phi(A) <= 1 - E_3(A)/mu(A).
